notes: South American perennial grown as annual outside zone 8. Highest steviol-glycoside content just before bloom.
harvestIndicators: Leaves at peak sweetness just before flowering

seasonalTasks.title: Pinch stevia tips for a bushier plant
seasonalTasks.body: Pinch the stem tips every 2 to 3 weeks so the plant branches out and grows bushier.

seasonalTasks.title: Pinch off stevia flower buds
seasonalTasks.body: Pinch off flower buds as soon as they appear. The leaves are sweetest before the plant flowers.
